summary: Iter95 verified the LucioDigital membership + payment gating end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter95_membership.py covering anonymous vs free vs paid gating, /api/membership/plans and /membership/me, favorites toggle, checkout ordering guard (monthly-before-setup=400), unknown kind/method=400, real Stripe checkout URLs for both card and bank (ACSS), full Interac flow (declare→admin confirm setup→setup_paid+still 402→declare monthly→confirm→paid+200 on /api/apps→31-day period end), reject path, suspend→402→reactivate→200, admin self-suspend=400, grandfathered admin=access 'admin', grandfathered lois4801@gmail.com=access 'paid', non-admin gets 402/403 on /api/admin/*, Stripe keys round-trip (never leaks the secret, rejects bad prefix, PUT updates publishable + Interac), admin email member sends. One real backend bug found and fixed: POST /api/admin/members/{id}/email crashed 500 because send_email() returns a string but membership.py did `.get('provider')` on it — fixed in /app/backend/membership.py to isinstance-check the response before .get. Frontend: /templates loads 33 template cards anonymously with nav-upgrade-btn visible; anonymous 'Use this template' redirects to /register?next=/templates; anonymous /dashboard,/leads redirect to /login; after registering a free user (via /api/auth/register) /dashboard and /leads correctly redirect to /upgrade; /upgrade renders both tiers ($1,000 setup + $300 monthly) and all three method cards (Card/Apple/Google Pay, Bank debit, Interac-Transfer); template-favorite-<key> star testid is rendered on every card. Admin: /admin/members shows 50 member-row items, member-search filter narrows to 1 for 'jaybernabe', 49 member-suspend buttons (admin's own row correctly missing it), member drawer opens with Stripe Payments section, member-mail-subject/body/send inputs and Send button all render. /account for admin shows account-status='Platform admin', setup='Included', 'No monthly billing on your account' and NO account-cancel-btn — grandfather behaviour correct. manual-queue card hides when there are no pending declarations (correct UX). Regression: admin login OK, /dashboard loads for admin, template gallery still renders 33 cards.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 (AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get') because send_email() returns a plain string in the resend path but membership.py treated it as a dict. FIXED in /app/backend/membership.py — provider now defaults to 'resend' and only reads dict.get when isinstance(res, dict). Re-tested with pytest test_admin_email_member → 200 with sent:true.

integration_issues.issue: Redirects to /register?next=/templates (login-then-signup path). The task expected /upgrade for authenticated free users specifically — that IS what happens after a free user registers (verified: /dashboard and /leads both go to /upgrade). For anonymous the current /register redirect is arguably correct: you cannot upgrade without an account. Leaving as informational.

action_items: None blocking. Verify the send_email fix (membership.py — POST /api/admin/members/{id}/email) is reviewed and merged; auto-tests will keep it regressed. Consider making send_email's return contract consistent across providers (always dict) so callers don't need isinstance guards.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/auth_extra.send_email returns different shapes per provider path (dict vs str) — this is the root cause of the 500. Normalise to always return {'provider': str, 'ok': bool} so every caller can safely .get().

backend/membership.py resolve_access: line 70 `if not end or end > now_iso() or not m.get('manual'):` treats a missing end as 'still paid' — a Stripe-paid member whose current_period_end is None would appear 'paid' forever. In practice invoice.paid always writes end, so low risk, but consider defaulting to False when both end is missing AND manual is False.

frontend/src/pages/AdminMembers.tsx: member row uses a repeated `data-testid="member-row"` (no user_id suffix) for every row — makes single-row targeting harder for automated tests. Consider `member-row-${user_id}` (member-open-* already uses this pattern).

rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/members/{user_id}/email returned 500 'AttributeError: str has no attribute get'. In backend/membership.py:427 the handler wrote `(res or {}).get('provider', 'resend')` but auth_extra.send_email() returns a plain provider-name string in the Resend success path, not a dict. Repro: admin session -> POST /api/admin/members/<uid>/email {subject, body} -> 500. Fix applied: only call .get when isinstance(res, dict) else default provider='resend'. Verified by pytest test_admin_email_member -> 200 sent:true. Longer-term fix: normalise send_email() to always return {'provider': ..., 'ok': ...}.
